title: Unsigned RERR enables route-invalidation DoS
description: Location: loadng.rs lines 456-464. The SECURITY comment explains unsigned RERR is acceptable but does not document attack scenarios. An attacker can forge RERR to invalidate routes (DoS). Document threat model and mitigations.
close_reason: Documented route-invalidation DoS threat model in RERR SECURITY comment: attack scenario, attacker capabilities, mitigations, and residual risk. Also fixed test compatibility issues from concurrent error_code type change.
